data.long_meaning: Saaimah is a beautiful and graceful name in Arabic and Urdu meaning 'healer' or 'helper'. This name is often given to girls who are believed to have a nurturing and compassionate nature, making them natural caregivers and supporters. Parents who choose Saaimah usually hope their child will grow to embody healer, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
